The Labour MP for Makerfield has stepped down, opening the way for Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham—seen by many as a potential challenger to Labour leader Keir Starmer—to contest the seat. A win would return Burnham to Parliament and potentially strengthen a leadership challenge within the Labour Party.

Once a safe Labour stronghold since 1906, Makerfield has seen shifting loyalties in recent years, with the Reform UK party gaining ground in local elections and traditional voter trust in Labour weakening.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Thousands of people gathered at the National Mall in Washington, DC for “Rededicate 250,” a mass prayer and worship event marking America’s upcoming 250th anniversary.

Organizers described the rally as a spiritual renewal movement tied to the “Freedom 250” campaign and a White House–backed initiative encouraging nationwide prayer groups. The event featured worship music, speeches from pastors, and messages from prominent conservative figures.

While supporters say the gathering reflects America’s religious heritage and freedom of faith, critics argue it highlights growing concerns over the influence of Christian nationalism in US politics.

The rally comes as the United States prepares to mark 250 years since its founding, amid ongoing debates over religion, patriotism, and national identity.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Fear is spreading across eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo after authorities confirmed an Ebola case in the city of Goma.

Rwanda has temporarily closed its main border crossing with Goma as a precautionary measure to prevent possible cross-border transmission, impacting one of the region’s busiest trade and travel routes.

The outbreak, first reported in Ituri province, has prompted increased surveillance and emergency health measures, as medical teams work to contain infections in Bunia and surrounding areas.

Residents say they are worried about the spread of the virus in a region already affected by ongoing insecurity and humanitarian challenges, with memories of past deadly Ebola outbreaks still fresh.

Health authorities say contact tracing and screening efforts are being reinforced, but concerns remain over response capacity in conflict-affected areas.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Tensions between the United States and Iran continue to escalate, with diplomatic efforts showing signs of strain and warnings of possible renewed military action.

Speaking to Al Jazeera, Trita Parsi of the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft said President Donald Trump is seriously considering further military steps, while both sides remain locked in a struggle over narrative and perceived victory.

Analysts warn that competing political pressures in Washington, Tehran, and Israel are complicating negotiations, with Gulf states also divided over the future direction of the conflict.

Meanwhile, Iran has warned it will respond with “surprising methods” if attacked again, raising fears of a wider regional escalation with potential global economic consequences.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
US President Donald Trump has warned Iran that “the clock is ticking” as negotiations between Washington and Tehran remain deadlocked amid rising regional tensions.

Trump’s comments came after Pakistan’s interior minister met Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in Tehran in an effort to support mediation efforts. Iranian officials responded defiantly, warning of “severe blows” against US interests if any new confrontation erupts.

Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates reported drone incursions into their airspace, including an incident near the UAE’s Barakah nuclear power plant, raising fears of a wider regional escalation.

Analysts say Gulf states are increasingly concerned about security, energy infrastructure and the economic fallout of a prolonged conflict.
